Priya: Kickoff for PEN-2026 retest. Target window 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC (2h). Single assessor, ephemeral role, KMS alias for decrypt. @Sam can you run ops?
Sam: Yep. Need exact IAM JSON + svc account list to retag. Will stand up export node if needed.
Priya: Minimal RBAC: role assessor/ephemeral (ttl=2h) with sts:AssumeRole, read-only on prod logs, kms:Decrypt on alias/pen-test-2026. Tag svc-pt-ingest, svc-log-exporter.
Jin: Audit snapshot plan: export auth_events, kms_decrypt_events, deploy_events to s3 as parquet + sha256 manifest. If export >10m use temporary replica.
Alex: Triage + release controls: create JIRA epic SEC-PT-2026. Each fix PR must include repro, test vector, rollback steps. Add label retest-required to block auto-deploys.
Priya: Acceptance criteria: 1) assessor only accesses allowed artifacts; 2) KMS decrypt events in CloudTrail snapshot; 3) repro fails against patched image during window; 4) PRs have regression tests. Fail -> pause retest.
assessor-bot: Dry-run scheduled 2026-03-28 16:00 UTC (DRY-RUN-5987). Run checklist against staging and report timing.
Sam: I'll run checklist after ACK from Priya/Jin/Alex.
Priya: Ack. Jin owns snapshot+manifest. Alex owns JIRA epic. Sam owns role + presigned S3 windows.
Jin: Running dry-run, will report if any timing issues.
Alex: Add gating canary test: rerun exploit repro against canary, attach expected output sample to ticket.
Priya: I'll post IAM snippets and short runbook here later today. :thumbsup:
